This file is a starter to increase the level of ground activity in BoB. Typically you will see an addition 30+ objects at each location. 
These range from trees to vehicles, to buildings.

To apply:
1) highlight and select the entire contents of this file below the line and then 
2) paste this into the bottom of your \Program Files\Rowan Software\Battle of Britain\bdg.txt file.
3) Save and close the bdg.txt file.
